title: A Fish Buried in the Sand Breathes Through Its Nose and Shocks at 50 Volts

scenes.text: Step here and the sand shocks you. Fifty volts.
The southern stargazer digs itself in with its fins in seconds. Only its eyes, nostrils and mouth stay above the sand.
It breathes through its nostrils, which have fringed combs that keep the sand out. Almost no other fish does that.
A small fish swims over. The stargazer erupts out of the sand and swallows it whole.
Grab it and two venomous spines above the fins get you. Then the organ behind its eyes fires up to 50 volts.
It grows to nearly two feet long, and you will never see it coming. Watch your step.

description:
A fish buried in the sand that breathes through its nose, ambushes prey from below, and shocks at up to 50 volts.
The southern stargazer digs itself in with its fins in seconds, leaving only its eyes, nostrils and mouth exposed. Unlike almost all fish, it draws water in through its nostrils, which have fringed combs to keep the sand out. It ambushes passing fish from below, carries venomous spines above its pectoral fins, and an electric organ behind its eyes delivers up to 50 volts. It grows to nearly 22 inches.
Which fish would you least like to step on?
subject: stargazer fish
first_comment: Its eyes sit on top of its head and point straight up, which is where the name comes from. Which hidden ocean animal scares you the most?
